Surfaces usage-based storage signals — per-table estimated row counts and, where the running version exposes it, approximate on-disk size — using only customer-safe SHOW surfaces (never crdb_internal, which is restricted in v26.2). Version-tolerant: signals a given version does not expose are returned as null rather than raising, and any query failure degrades to an empty result instead of throwing the whole summary. TableStorage Cockroach Plenum storage signal for a single table. Rows and Bytes are best-effort: they are null when the running CockroachDB version does not expose that signal, rather than failing. Interfaces IStorageInsights Read-only Cockroach Plenum storage insights: usage-based storage signals per table using only customer-safe surfaces.
